name.ja: BB戦士222 鎧丸（ヨロイマル）

ja: コミックボンボンにて好評連載中の「武者○伝」に登場する「鎧丸」がプラモデルで登場。全身の鎧を組替えて「城塞モード」に変形可能。
双絶刀（２本）、ダブルビームライフルの武器が付属。
en: The "Yorimaru " that appears in " Musha○den ", which is being serialized in Comic Bonbon, is now available as a plastic model. Can be transformed into " castle mode" by rearranging the armor of the whole body.
Comes with two double beam rifle weapons.
